milestones.task: till dirt into farmland with hoe
milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_least(kind='block', object='farmland') because the task requires transforming a dirt block into farmland by using a hoe. Farmland cannot be picked up in Survival mode so inventory_has is not applicable. We check for at least 1 farmland block in a generous region around the dirt patch to confirm the tilling action was performed.
